settings.headline: Accessibility statement
settings.subtitle: Saskell Creek Public Schools wants every family, student and community member to be able to use this site. This is an illustrative statement for a fictional district.

settings.headline: What we commit to
settings.intro: These commitments come from board Policy 1450, Website accessibility.

items.title: WCAG 2.1 AA
items.text: Pages, documents and videos are designed to meet WCAG 2.1 level AA.

items.title: Text first
items.text: Schedules, menus, agendas and policies are published as web pages, not scanned PDFs.

items.title: Status not by color alone
items.text: Every status on this site is written in words as well as shown in color.

items.title: Captions
items.text: Board meeting recordings are captioned; live meetings have live captions.

items.title: A named person
items.text: Report a barrier to Bettina Okonkwo, accessibility and Section 504 coordinator, at (555) 014-1030. We respond within five school days.

settings.headline: How this site is built
settings.body: Every page is rendered on the server as plain HTML, with a skip link, real headings and visible focus outlines. Text is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible, a typeface designed for readers with low vision. The site works without JavaScript.
settings.aside: Call (555) 014-1030 or tell any front office. There is no web form on this example site, on purpose.
